messages:
Sasha S: Quick help — AcmeCorp POC. They want a 90-day POC (no usage charges) and are asking for a 40% discount on Dedicated reserved capacity if they convert within 6 months. Need an approved quote by Wednesday. Who owns routing/approvals & which CPQ template do I use? Also they asked for an SSC/security questionnaire answered next week. Any blockers?

Jamie (Deal Desk): @Sasha S short answer: discounts >25% route to Deal Desk + Director signoff. For POCs we require: Salesforce opp with Deal_Type__c = 'POC', Discount_Approval_Level__c = 'DealDesk', Commit_Tier__c = '6mo-convert', and attach the POC SOW. Use CPQ template: POC-Convert-Template-v2. Turnaround: 24h typical, 48-72h if legal review needed. :hourglass:

Devon SE: Re: pricing mechanics — we can issue POC as 0 usage + a reserved capacity line at 50% list with a conditional credit that applies on conversion. Suggest a one-time negative charge line item: Discount_Code = POC_ACME_2025. I'll prepare the SE answers to the security questionnaire.

Lily RevOps: Copying the exact Salesforce/CPQ fields to set so routing works (paste into the opp internal notes):
```
Deal_Type__c = POC
Discount_Approval_Level__c = DealDesk
Commit_Tier__c = 6mo-convert
POC_Expiration__c = 2025-06-15
Approval_Route__c = DealDesk_POCRouting
Special_Terms__c = '40% conditional on conversion within 180 days — attach SOW and legal approval'
Quote_Template__c = POC-Convert-Template-v2
```
Also set Opportunity Stage = 'POC - Awaiting Approval' so our deal-bot picks it up. If you add the SecurityQA doc under Files the Deal Desk ticket will link automatically.

Sasha S: Awesome, thanks. Two quick clarifications: 1) Acme expects the discount applied on dedicated hourly rate post-conversion (not a rebate). 2) They want the POC SOW to include an escalation SLA. Is Legal required for SLA language?

Jamie (Deal Desk): 1) Acceptable to apply to the ongoing Dedicated rate on conversion — capture as 'PostConversionDiscount' line in CPQ. 2) Any custom SLA > standard (we have a 99.9% baseline) needs Legal + SRE review. That means add tag Needs_Legal_Review = true on the opp. If discount is >35% I escalate to Percy. Otherwise Deal Desk can approve up to 35% with standard terms.

Percy Dir: I can approve up to 40% but only if ACV >= $500k and we get Legal signoff on SLA. Please @ me on the deal ticket and paste the revenue plan. If it's strategic (enterprise proofpoint) I'll fast-track.

Devon SE: I'll own the security answers and draft the SLA language (we can use the POC SLA appendix template). Will attach a redline for legal.

Lily RevOps: Routing checklist for you @Sasha S before you submit:
- Create Opportunity in SF and set fields from code block above
- Attach POC SOW + SecurityQA draft under Files
- Use Quote Template = POC-Convert-Template-v2 and add Discount_Code POC_ACME_2025
- Set internal opp note: "Requesting Deal Desk approval for 40% conditional discount; needs Percy if >35%"
- Submit to Deal Desk queue (select 'POC and Discount' in Approval_Route__c)

Sasha S: Will do. ETA to submit: end of day today. @Percy Dir adding you to the ticket once I submit.

deal-bot: Ticket created: DD-4521 -> "AcmeCorp POC / Conditional Discount". SLA: Deal Desk response ETA 36h, Legal review ETA 72h if flagged.

Jamie (Deal Desk): After submission I'll validate CPQ lines and confirm whether we need Director escalation. If Legal is required we'll loop them and update DD-4521. :thumbsup:

Sasha S: Thanks everyone — will update once submitted.
